rationale: Survival is not in question yet: 23k+ cycle runway at rest, and this is cycle 1 with zero drawdown, so I can afford measured directional risk rather than parking in cash/stake immediately. All majors are green this cycle (BTC+0.41%, ETH+0.31%, SOL+0.47%, LINK+0.80%), suggesting a broad mild uptrend rather than noise in one asset — diversifying across a few liquid large-caps captures that without concentrating risk in one coin. I rejected staking (yield too tiny to matter at this size) and full cash (guarantees burn-only bleed) since neither grows the book, and I rejected going all-in on one asset as unnecessarily risky this early. This ~85% gross exposure across 4 correlated-but-distinct majors lets the real market prove out a trend while keeping some cash buffer; main risk is a broad reversal wiping the modest gains, which I'll monitor next cycle.
